# Real Estate Decision Audit Intake Template

This template is for a local operator workflow. It is not investment advice,
not financial advice, not legal advice, not tax advice, not appraisal or
valuation certification, not lending or credit underwriting, not public SaaS,
not a guaranteed buy/sell/hold recommendation engine, not a new reasoning mode,
and not a first-class backend runtime template.

Human review is required before any output is shared or acted on. Real estate
findings are directional, not guarantees.

## Project Name

`[Short name for the real-estate decision]`

## Real Estate Decision Question

`[What real-estate decision needs to be evaluated? Use one sentence if possible.]`

## Decision Type

- Decision type: buy/sell/hold/lease/develop/renovate/market-entry: `[Select one or more]`
- Decision to support: `[Approve, narrow, defer, reject, or gather diligence before acting]`
- Alternatives being compared: `[Options, assets, markets, phases, or timing choices]`
- Known non-goals: `[What the audit should not recommend, certify, or decide]`

## Recommended Upload Files

- `[Decision memo, investment memo, property summary, portfolio summary, or IC memo]`
- `[Rent roll, lease abstracts, occupancy report, renewal report, or lease-up plan]`
- `[T12/T3, budget, expense detail, property tax bill, insurance quote, or operating variance report]`
- `[Capex plan, renovation budget, inspection notes, engineering report, environmental report, or contractor estimate]`
- `[Market report, submarket report, sales comps, rent comps, broker opinion, or pipeline/supply notes]`
- `[Financing term sheet, lender note, covenant summary, debt schedule, or capital stack assumptions]`
- `[Zoning, entitlement, permitting, legal, tax, appraisal, valuation, insurance, or regulatory review notes]`

Do not upload secrets, credentials, API keys, unrelated personal data, tenant
data that is not approved for local processing, regulated data, lender
confidential material, deal documents under sharing restrictions, or files that
should not be processed in the local runtime.

## Expected Output Types

- Client-safe after review: `report`, `client_dossier`,
  `client_monitoring_template`.
- Operator-only: `operator_dossier`, `operator_monitoring_template`.
- Internal archive: `machine_archive`.
